reviewHistory.summary: T732's production comparator changes correctly implement sporting-quality ordering while preserving request bands and financial verdicts; the reviewer reran scout-search.test.ts and all 16 passed. The measurement harness has a blocking free-arrival accounting error, so its paid/free reports cannot yet support the economic comparison. Fix the reporting and add a small synthetic regression; no simulation-rule expansion is needed.

findings.message: The events list requires event.currency===closed.currency before counting free-agent-signing, but signFreeAgentAtClose calls addEvent without an amount and addEvent only attaches currency when amount exists. Every such top-up is therefore discarded and freeTopUpArrivals is always zero. A direct addEvent synthetic reproduction yields a free-agent-signing event without currency and filtered count0. Free arrivals also depend on completed bid history, which is capped at60 by transfers.ts:pruneBids, while recordTransfer deliberately records no zero-fee facts. Count these nonmonetary arrival facts separately from currency-filtered money, and preserve complete per-season free counts rather than depending on a prunable bid buffer. Add a small regression including a currency-less top-up and free delegated arrival, and expose correct raw source evidence so existing cash-flow runs can be repaired/reported accurately.

No blocking finding; T732's separate harness must consume this helper and receive its own review.
